create_VllmIRLoweringPass: create a VllmIRLoweringPass instance with a VllmConfig to lower vLLM IR ops to their implementations
run_VllmIRLoweringPass: run the VllmIRLoweringPass on an fx.Graph to lower all vLLM IR nodes to concrete implementations
get_default_overload: get the default OpOverload from an OpOverloadPacket or return the OpOverload unchanged
get_ir_op: get the IrOp registry entry from an fx.Node if it represents a vLLM IR operation
build_VllmIRLoweringPass_uuid: build a cache key uuid string from IR op priorities and implementation provider uuids
